output.summary: KEP-6178 (Concurrent Watch Object Decode, sig-api-machinery) is at status implementable, stage beta. It proposes decoding watch objects concurrently; the implementation PR kubernetes/kubernetes#139679 was merged before code freeze, which let the KEP be tracked for code freeze in v1.37.
output.rationale: The KEP was at risk for enhancements freeze until its readme/PRR PR (kubernetes/enhancements#6179) was resolved, and it was then tracked for enhancements freeze. At code freeze the enhancement was first removed from the v1.37 milestone because implementation PRs were not merge-ready, then re-added after PR #139679 merged with an updated description. The stated benefit is from a Kueue user: the previous behavior caused a boot incident, and benchmarks show about 3.4x more workloads processed.

alternatives.option: Leave the KEP out of v1.37 after code freeze
alternatives.why_not: The sources show it was re-added to the v1.37 milestone after PR kubernetes/kubernetes#139679 merged with an updated description, so it was not left out.

alternatives.option: Track total active decode goroutines as the observability metric
alternatives.why_not: Jefftree preferred a gauge, stating 'I added a gauge for apiserver_watch_decode_inflight' instead of describing goroutines.

alternatives.option: Use queue depth or delay as the observability signal for decode
alternatives.why_not: Jefftree said queue delay already exists via logs: 'when decoder is falling behind and crosses a threshold' a block logger records it.

evidence.quote: Pertaining to the concerned PR https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/139679 being merged and with an updated description, this KEP is now marked as `Tracked for code freeze`.
the implementation (code-related) PRs associated with this enhancement are not in the merge-ready state by code-freeze and hence this enhancement is now removed from the v1.37 milestone.
I added a gauge for `apiserver_watch_decode_inflight`. (b) exists already via logs.
the previous behavior caused us an incident as reported here: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/136950 where Kueue could not boot up.
